title: YoY growth with SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR
task: Write a measure: VAR Cur = total SalesAmount, VAR PY = same period last year, RETURN DIVIDE(Cur − PY, PY).
answer: VAR Cur = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) VAR PY = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])) RETURN DIVIDE(Cur - PY, PY)

title: YTD margin
context: Combine time intelligence with a ratio.
task: Write a measure: VAR R = TOTALYTD(total SalesAmount, Date[Date]), VAR C = TOTALYTD(total CostAmount, Date[Date]) RETURN DIVIDE(R − C, R).
answer: VAR R = TOTALYTD(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Date]) VAR C = TOTALYTD(SUM(Sales[CostAmount]), Date[Date]) RETURN DIVIDE(R - C, R)

title: Rank Electronics among categories
context: RANKX over all categories by their sales.
task: Write a measure ranking the total for category 'Electronics' among all categories: RANKX(ALL(Product[Category]), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Product[Category]="Electronics")).

title: Rank of the priciest product
task: Write a measure = RANKX(ALL(Product), Product[Price], MAXX(Product, Product[Price])).

title: Overall discount rate
context: Discount weighted by revenue, not a simple mean.
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(SUMX(Sales, Sales[SalesAmount] * Sales[Discount]), SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])).

title: Electronics share ignoring filters
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Product[Category]="Electronics"), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), ALL(Product))).

title: 2024 Electronics margin
task: Write a measure: VAR R = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year]=2024, Product[Category]="Electronics"), VAR C = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[CostAmount]), Date[Year]=2024, Product[Category]="Electronics") RETURN DIVIDE(R − C, R).
hint: Same two filters on both VARs.
answer: VAR R = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year] = 2024, Product[Category] = "Electronics") VAR C = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[CostAmount]), Date[Year] = 2024, Product[Category] = "Electronics") RETURN DIVIDE(R - C, R)

title: Profit from list prices
context: Profit if no discounts were given.
task: Write a measure = SUMX(Sales, Sales[Quantity] * (RELATED(Product[Price]) − RELATED(Product[Cost]))).

title: Revenue lost to discounts
task: Write a measure = SUMX(Sales, Sales[Quantity] * RELATED(Product[Price])) − SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]).

title: Sales of above-average-price products
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount from products priced above the average product price, using CALCULATE and FILTER(Product, Product[Price] > AVERAGE(Product[Price])).
hint: FILTER the Product table by the average.

title: YoY change amount
task: Write a measure: VAR Cur = total SalesAmount, VAR PY = same period last year, RETURN Cur − PY.
answer: VAR Cur = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) VAR PY = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])) RETURN Cur - PY

title: Safe YoY with fallback
context: DIVIDE returns blank on zero; supply 0.
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) − CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])), 0).
hint: Third DIVIDE argument is the fallback.

title: High-value order count
task: Write a measure counting Sales rows where SalesAmount > 2000, using COUNTROWS and FILTER.

title: Average revenue per product
task: Write a measure = AVERAGEX(Product, CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]))).
hint: CALCULATE inside AVERAGEX applies the product row as a filter.

title: Max customer revenue
task: Write a measure = MAXX(Customer, CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]))).

title: Corporate share of quantity
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), Customer[Segment]="Corporate"), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALL(Customer))).

title: Growth classification
task: Write a measure: VAR G = DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) − CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date]))) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), G > 0.1, "High", G > 0, "Low", "Decline").
answer: VAR G = DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]) - CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date])), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Date[Date]))) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), G > 0.1, "High", G > 0, "Low", "Decline")

title: 2023 Furniture sales
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount where year is 2023 and category is 'Furniture'.

title: Average effective unit price
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), SUM(Sales[Quantity])).

title: Distinct categories sold
context: Count distinct categories via a table function.
task: Write a measure counting distinct product categories that appear, using COUNTROWS and DISTINCT(Product[Category]).

title: Cost-to-sales ratio
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(SUM(Sales[CostAmount]), SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])).

title: Product-weighted margin
context: Margin over the product table via CALCULATE.
task: Write a measure = AVERAGEX(Product, DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])) - CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[CostAmount])), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])))).
hint: CALCULATE inside AVERAGEX for each product's sales and cost.

title: Electronics YoY change
task: Write a measure: VAR Cur = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year]=2024, Product[Category]="Electronics"), VAR Prev = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year]=2023, Product[Category]="Electronics") RETURN Cur − Prev.
answer: VAR Cur = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year] = 2024, Product[Category] = "Electronics") VAR Prev = CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year] = 2023, Product[Category] = "Electronics") RETURN Cur - Prev

title: North contribution to 2024
task: Write a measure = DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year]=2024, Customer[Region]="North"), CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[SalesAmount]), Date[Year]=2024)).
